h7: Large networks route you to whichever vehicle is nearest. The result is uneven: a different stranger each time, a call center between you and the person driving. h8: You work with one accountable partner — whoever is assigned, the standard is the same, and one person stands behind it.

h19: Your chauffeur is briefed on pickup details, passenger count, and any preferences on file before the ride begins.
